projects.name: QueryMind
projects.short_description: AI-powered natural language to SQL assistant
projects.problem: Users without SQL knowledge may find it difficult to query and understand information stored in databases.
projects.solution: QueryMind allows users to ask questions in natural language, converts them into SQL queries, retrieves the relevant database information, and presents the result in an understandable way.
projects.my_role: Designed and developed the backend, database schema, LLM integration, query analysis, and ambiguity-handling logic.
challenges: Handling ambiguous natural-language queries without making incorrect assumptions
Connecting natural-language questions with the database schema
Ensuring generated answers accurately reflected database results
projects.what_i_learned: Learned how to integrate LLMs with databases and design systems that ask for clarification instead of making assumptions when user queries are ambiguous.

projects.name: AI-Based Farmer Query Support System
projects.short_description: AI-powered agricultural advisory platform for rural users
projects.problem: Farmers may face difficulty accessing agricultural guidance because of language, accessibility, and technology barriers.
projects.solution: A responsive AI-powered agricultural advisory platform designed to provide accessible and multilingual support through text, voice, and image-based crop queries.
projects.my_role: Worked as a UI/UX and frontend developer, designing interfaces in Figma and building responsive screens using React, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Also contributed to basic login and signup functionality.
challenges: Designing an interface accessible to rural users
Supporting multiple query methods and multilingual interaction
projects.what_i_learned: Learned how to design technology around accessibility and real-world user needs, particularly for users with different levels of digital familiarity.

projects.name: Mental Health Score Prediction System
projects.short_description: ML-powered mental health score prediction web application
projects.problem: Estimating mental health scores from social media usage, lifestyle, and demographic factors.
projects.solution: An end-to-end machine learning web application that predicts mental health scores from user-provided information.
projects.my_role: Developed the machine learning application end-to-end, including the FastAPI backend, input validation, model integration, frontend, and deployment.
challenges: Integrating the trained machine learning model with a FastAPI backend
Validating user inputs before generating predictions
projects.what_i_learned: Learned how to connect a machine learning model with a web application, build APIs with FastAPI, and deploy an end-to-end ML project.

projects.name: MoodMate
projects.short_description: AI-powered sentiment and emotion analysis application
projects.problem: Understanding the emotional tone of user-provided text.
projects.solution: An AI-based application that analyzes text and identifies the underlying emotion or sentiment.
projects.my_role: Developed the machine learning model and contributed to the backend and frontend integration.
projects.what_i_learned: Gained hands-on experience in NLP, text classification, model integration, and connecting machine learning with a web application.
